acceptance_rules: Every prompt should define files, checks, and bounded outcomes.
forbidden_work: Do not spill into adjacent features or repos without being asked.

required_fields.description: State the allowed paths and responsibility boundary.
required_fields.name: scope

required_fields.description: State what the agent must not touch.
required_fields.name: forbidden_work

expected_outputs.description: Validated Dex prompt template for Dex Prompt Template.
expected_outputs.name: dex_prompt

implementation_notes: Prompt templates should define exact scope, acceptance, and forbidden work rather than motivational prose.
Keep prompts short enough that Dex can act, not reinterpret a novel.
known_failure_modes: Dex Prompt Template still requires heroic interpretation because acceptance criteria are weak.
Forbidden work is absent, so prompt-driven edits drift into adjacent lanes.
name: Dex Prompt Template
problem_solved: Defines bounded prompt structure so Dex Prompt Template can drive narrow Dex or Codex tasks.

required_inputs.description: Prompt type such as skeleton, component, logic, test, or review.
required_inputs.name: task_kind

required_inputs.description: Non-negotiable outcomes the prompt must enforce.
required_inputs.name: acceptance_criteria

summary: Machine-first template for bounded Dex or Codex prompts.
when_not_to_use: Do not use when Dex Prompt Template would still require heroic interpretation from Dex.
Do not use when the prompt cannot yet state acceptance criteria or forbidden work.
when_to_use: Use when Dex Prompt Template should produce bounded implementation prompts instead of monster briefs.
Use when Dex needs explicit scope, allowed files, acceptance criteria, and forbidden work.
